notes: This booklet really builds separate models, so the 6 groups are intentionally NOT connected. Page 2 shows two bags: bag 1 builds loose cargo and bag 2 builds the crane truck. Page 3 and page 4 start with bag 1 only. The cargo is built as five independent items, and nothing in the booklet fastens them to each other or to the truck: the red container (b1-b19), the grey open container (b20-b34), canister stack 1 (b35-b38), canister stack 2 (b39-b42) and the pallet with four red tanks (b43-b54; page 11 builds the canisters and pallet separately). The sixth group is the container-stacker truck with crane (b55-b214). The truck only lifts or carries the cargo in play (see the front cover), which is not an assembly step.
The minifigure is not in the parts list and is not recorded.

The parts list totals 214 and the ids b1-b214 match it exactly, per type and colour. The sticker sheet (lego-59832) is b214; it is joined to the crane arm b181 (the 'Max. 10 T' label) so it is not a stray piece.

Convention for rests_on: it lists the already-built pieces that a new piece clutches, in booklet order, including pieces added from below (feet under the container base plates, the bottom red 2x2 plate under the beams, the yellow 2x4 plates under the beam ends). The container bases are shown upside-down in the booklet, so their feet (b2-b7, b21-b26) list the base plate as support.
Side-mounted pieces (grille tiles and green slopes on bracket faces, tools in clips, axles, pins, hinge parts, rods, wheels) are recorded in other_joins and have rests_on [].

The footsteps (step 16) are four lego-6636 tiles. Since a tile has no studs, none rests on another tile: b106-b109 are all recorded as resting on the 2x6 deck b92 (the booklet draws each footstep as two tiles stacked, with a mesh sticker; this stacking is not modelled).

Several attachments are not clear from the small pictures, so these are assumptions: exact rests_on neighbours of the container panels/pillars/top plates; which sides the black/tan pins sit; which green slope or plate sits on which; which grille tile sits on which bracket (the ten grille tiles are spread over steps 7, 8, 14, 20, 21 and 29); the placement of the six round 1x1 bricks (two carry the goblets); and the second 3710 plate.

Wheels: 6 rims + 6 tyres. Axle 7 (b196) carries two wheels at the red-plate end through b65/b66, and axle 10 (b201) carries four wheels at the bracket/grille end through b63/b64. This is inferred from steps 33-37.

The crane arm: inner boom (b177 beam with b178 thin beam, hinge b179, hook b180) slides into outer arm b181. Two rods (axle 10 + bush + connector + red bush) run from the arm into the hydraulic sleeves b80/b81, which sit on the tan axle pins. Red axles b192/b193 pivot the arm on the rear beams b137/b138.
Position is null for every piece, as instructed.
